page.layout: One printed page of running text, scanned sideways. Four blocks of faint lines: an upper block, a middle block, a lower block, and a short block near the foot. No margin notes, running head, page number or catchword can be read.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and rotated about ninety degrees. The lines show only as grey marks, and no word can be read with confidence, so every line is marked illegible and the letter counts are estimates. Paragraph breaks are guessed from the spacing of the lines. Scattered specks and stains are not printed text and are omitted. No heading, running head, page number, catchword or signature can be made out.
